items.headline: Non-Executive Director (part-time) — SBS Board / Special Broadcasting Service Corporation (Sydney)
items.summary: Part-time federal statutory board seat on the SBS Corporation board for a term of up to five years (~$67,500 p.a.), with at least six full-day board meetings a year plus optional Audit & Risk or other committee service; managed by Omera Partners.
items.so_what: A high-calibre statutory directorship squarely in your FAICD governance wheelhouse with an Audit & Risk committee pathway; applications close 9am AEST this morning (6 Aug) — lodge the online application and resume immediately if you have not already.
items.source: Australian Government (Dept of Infrastructure) / Omera Partners

items.headline: Treasurer & Chair, Finance, Audit & Risk Committee (Non-Executive Director) — Australasian Menopause Society (national / interstate)
items.summary: AMS is recruiting an experienced finance and governance professional to join its board as Treasurer and Chair of its Finance, Audit & Risk Committee, overseeing financial stewardship, reporting and risk for the peak health body.
items.so_what: An almost tailor-made match for your FCPA/FAICD profile — the Treasurer plus Chair-of-FARC remit is exactly your finance-and-governance sweet spot; board cadence makes the national/interstate footprint workable, so register your interest promptly.

items.headline: Non-Executive Director / Treasurer — ADSSI Limited (Central Coast & Northern Sydney)
items.summary: Community aged and disability care not-for-profit seeking a financially literate director to fill a retiring director/treasurer seat.
items.so_what: Direct match to your FCPA/FAICD profile — an explicit finance/treasurer skills gap on an established NFP board within commuting reach; register interest promptly.

items.so_what: Finance-skilled directors are explicitly sought — a credible NFP board seat within reach; register interest if the mission appeals.

items.so_what: The treasurer seat is a clean fit for your accounting credential and existing board experience, with a light meeting load close to home — worth a prompt expression of interest.

items.so_what: A straightforward way to add a current directorship; the treasurer remit maps directly to your FCPA background, though the org is smaller-scale.

items.headline: Chief Financial Officer — Cancer Council NSW (Sydney)
items.summary: Executive finance lead for one of the state's largest health NFPs, owning financial strategy, reporting and controls across a complex, purpose-led organisation.
items.so_what: A genuine C-suite finance seat in the NFP/health sector that fits your FCPA profile and sector affinities; a strong role but a competitive executive search — worth a considered application.

items.headline: Senior Manager — Risk — SBS / Special Broadcasting Service (North Shore / Sydney)
items.summary: Owns and continuously improves SBS's enterprise risk management framework, policies and corporate risk register, partnering with leaders across the business to identify, assess and manage strategic and operational risks.
items.so_what: A core senior-manager target on the money for your enterprise-risk and governance strengths, in Sydney; a direct, actionable match — apply promptly and verify the latest status on SBS Careers.

items.so_what: An operational-resilience/crisis leadership seat that draws on your risk and operations strengths and IT/technology exposure; a 'Head of' level role in Sydney — worth pursuing if operational risk/resilience appeals.
